rows: - 16 Nov, scripted model for the offload `ask` e2e group (issue #83 E3 step 4; test type: e2e plus flow, local, n=1, no network and no `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`). New `exec_testkit::FakeModel` (`fake-model`, an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions server) behind `OpencodeServer::start_scripted` (the `opencode-go` provider's baseURL set through `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT`); the `ask` group runs on it, the parity groups stay on the live model and the vault key. `cargo test -p offload --test e2e -- ask::` took 20 s with 5 of 6 passing (session continue with PELICAN, edit with and without the read-only agent, repository agent, loopback service); the sixth, `the_recorded_options_are_the_ones_opencode_run_lists_now`, fails here only because the local opencode is 1.19.5 and dropped `--share` against the 1.19.0 the job pins. Flow tests (4, 33 s) pin the SSE protocol and the request shape the real `opencode run` sends. Decision: keep; the live ask run (minutes, 3 attempts, flaky by design) is replaced by a 20 s run. Not measured: a hosted run.
